onset.Description: Onset of the event relative to recording start

trial_type.Description: Phase of the trapezoidal isometric ankle-dorsiflexion contraction at 10% MVC, following the protocol described in the dataset (linear ramps at 5%/s, 20 s plateau). Event onsets/durations were inserted for this test fixture because the source EDF contained no embedded annotations.

Levels.ramp_up: Linear increase of target torque from 0 to 10% MVC at 5%/s
Levels.ramp_down: Linear decrease of target torque from 10% MVC to 0 at 5%/s
